simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שׁוֹבֵב (H7728) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שׁוֹבֵב (shôwbêb) means apostate , i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen First listed occurrence: Jer 31 22.

definitions.full: H7728. shobeb שׁוֺבֵב adjective backturning, apostate (perhaps for ׳מְשׁוֺ , see I. שׁוֺבָב ); — as substantive, ׳לְשׁו Micah 2:4 (but read probably שׁוֺבֵינוּ our captors ); feminine הַשּׁוֺבֵבָה הַבַּת Jer 31:22 (of Israel), 49:4 (of Ammon).
